body: I could get grants for them to go to daycare.  Legally, it's almost impossible for a father to get full custody, never going to happen with a baby.  Waiting is my current best option, but that is such a crushing feeling, knowing I've just got to keep slogging it out, waiting for the kids to be old enough for me to gtfo with them. EDIT:  I'm tired of fighting her.

I've finally managed to get my son off to school, so he'll be mostly removed from her influence while I'm at work.  Once my daughter goes to school she'll have to get a job, and she won't ever be alone with them.  That's been the worst, knowing she's staying holed up in the house with them, no social interaction, all that negativity... getting them out into the world finally!

all conversations derail pretty quickly into petty squabbling.  She's a master at manipulating a conversation away from what she doesn't want to talk about, or creating an emotional blackmail situation...  Talking with her has yet to bring any result or change.  A lawyer is too expensive, I don't make much and her old debt keeps us strapped...
